source_name: Тендер онлайн / TenderOnline (ПП "ТЕНДЕР ОНЛАЙН") — accredited marketplace incl. Prozorro Market
why_relevant: Accredited operator covering Prozorro, Prozorro Market (e-catalogue) and ProZorro.Sale auctions in one place. Prozorro Market matters for banking/payments because low-value repeat purchases (consumables, receipt rolls, small IT) migrate to the catalogue rather than open tenders — a stream easily missed.

source_name: NEWTEND (ТОВ "НЬЮТЕНД") — accredited Prozorro marketplace
why_relevant: Listed as a currently accredited marketplace on the official ProZorro operator register; named explicitly in the cell scope. Another independent republication + alerting channel worth mapping for coverage completeness and for its own buyer/supplier directories.

source_name: IZI.TRADE (ТОВ "ІЗІ.Трейд") — accredited marketplace with public search documentation
why_relevant: Accredited operator that publishes open how-to documentation for its tender search (search by buyer, keyword/phrase, procurement identifier). The docs disclose the query syntax and filter surface, which is exactly what an automated collector needs to build reproducible keyword monitors for banking/payments categories.

source_name: PlayTender — accredited Prozorro marketplace with commercial procurement stream
why_relevant: Accredited operator explicitly positioning itself as both a state-tender platform and a COMMERCIAL procurement marketplace ("майданчик комерційних закупівель"). Another below-threshold/private channel where bank and fintech buyers can post outside the central portal.

source_name: Українська універсальна біржа — Prozorro portal (tender.uub.com.ua)
why_relevant: Accredited operator run by a commodity exchange rather than an IT startup — a structurally different actor type. Publishes explanatory pages about Prozorro marketplaces (pro-prozorro/maydanchyky-prozorro) that act as a secondary pointer/cross-check on the operator landscape.

source_name: Zakupki.com.ua — private Prozorro tender aggregator/portal
why_relevant: Independent aggregator republishing Prozorro state procurement with its own navigation and search. Aggregators like this often expose lightweight, scrape-friendly HTML and category taxonomies that the primary operators hide behind logins — a practical fallback collection route.

source_name: Tender.in.ua — open tender aggregator for business
why_relevant: Long-running commercial tender aggregator positioned at business bidders ("конкурсні торги, закупівлі для бізнесу"). Aggregators of this type historically also carry non-Prozorro commercial and donor/IFI tenders, which is where private bank and payment-processor sourcing sometimes surfaces.

source_name: Clarity Project — commercial procurement & counterparty analytics platform
why_relevant: Paid analytics layer that merges Prozorro tenders with 140+ Ukrainian registers, giving supplier/buyer dossiers, contract histories and affiliation links. For a market-intel programme this is the fastest route from an award notice to 'who actually won, who owns them, what else they sell'. Notably, a Clarity Project licence is itself sold ON Prozorro Market — meaning its own purchase records are traceable, revealing which state bodies monitor procurement.

source_name: YouControl — company dossier & register-monitoring service (tender module)
why_relevant: Subscription analytics building dossiers on every Ukrainian company from 40+ open-data sources, with daily change alerts. Used alongside tender data to resolve which legal entity behind a winning bid belongs to which banking-technology group, and to detect new market entrants registering shortly before winning.

source_name: Infobox Prozorro — official knowledge base article on procurement monitoring tools
why_relevant: Prozorro's own knowledge base enumerates the monitoring instruments available (public and paid analytics modules, third-party services). An authoritative, low-noise pointer for validating which monitoring services are considered legitimate parts of the ecosystem — and for the correct Ukrainian terminology to use in further queries.

source_name: Ministry of Economy (Mineconomy) — official listing of procurement information sources and analytical tools
why_relevant: Government-published inventory titled 'Інформаційні джерела та аналітичні інструменти сфери публічних закупівель' — a state-sanctioned map of where procurement information lives, including third-party analytics. High-credibility seed for expanding the aggregator/monitoring cell beyond what search engines surface.

source_name: Prozorro.Sale broker/marketplace directory (майданчики ЕТС Prozorro.Продажі)
why_relevant: Parallel accredited-operator network for the SALE/auction side. Directly banking-relevant: liquidated-bank asset sales (Deposit Guarantee Fund lots) and state property are sold through these brokers, exposing bank hardware/branch estates and the buyers who acquire them. Separate accreditation levels per broker are listed.

source_name: State Property Fund of Ukraine — authorised Prozorro.Sale platforms list (small privatisation)
why_relevant: Independent, government-maintained cross-check on which sale-side marketplaces are authorised. Useful for validating operator status when the marketplaces' own claims conflict, and for detecting accreditation changes.

source_name: Zakupki.Prom mobile app listing (App Store, UA) — alerting/monitoring product surface
why_relevant: App-store listings and their changelogs document what monitoring/alerting features an operator ships and when — a cheap, stable proxy for tracking product evolution of the marketplace sector without needing paid accounts. Review text also surfaces user complaints about data coverage.

source_name: SIRIUS law firm — tender-monitoring service (моніторинг тендерних майданчиків)
why_relevant: Example of the professional-services tier of tender monitoring (law firms selling monitoring across marketplaces rather than software). Their service descriptions enumerate which marketplaces they cover — an indirect but useful cross-check on which platforms practitioners consider worth monitoring for a given sector.

source_name: ua-region.com.ua company record for ТОВ "ЗАКУПКИ.ПРОМ.УА" (EDRPOU 40283641)
why_relevant: Demonstrates the resolution path from marketplace brand -> legal entity -> EDRPOU code -> registry data (directors, KVED, address). Needed to link marketplace operators to their corporate groups and to detect ownership changes in the aggregator market itself.

source_name: DOZORRO — громадський контроль публічних закупівель (TI Ukraine)
why_relevant: Flagship Ukrainian procurement watchdog portal run by Transparency International Ukraine. Aggregates per-tender feedback, community monitoring, official complaints and links straight back to Prozorro tender IDs (e.g. UA-2020-02-24-002415-c pattern). Primary jump-off point for identifying problem buyers of banking/payments IT (NBU, Oschadbank, PrivatBank, Ukrposhta) and the civic monitors who track them.

source_name: DOZORRO Blog — аналітичні матеріали та розслідування
why_relevant: The narrative layer that explains WHY tenders are structured as they are: analyses of the most active complainants at AMCU, 'companies that win right after registration', penalties for Prozorro violations. Directly useful to interpret single-bidder and spec-tailoring patterns in banking/payments equipment tenders.

source_name: Transparency International Ukraine — Research / Public Procurement
why_relevant: TI Ukraine is the methodological authority behind DOZORRO and BI Prozorro. Its research section publishes procurement risk methodologies, savings estimates (~UAH 2bn claimed saved in 2024 via monitoring) and topical studies that name recurring problem buyers — the interpretive backbone for A2 tender intelligence.

source_name: RISE Ukraine Coalition (Reconstruction, Integrity, Sustainability, Efficiency)
why_relevant: Coalition of 40+ Ukrainian and international CSOs co-initiated with the Ministry for Restoration; drives the DREAM reconstruction-transparency ecosystem. Sets the transparency norms and datasets that will govern reconstruction-linked contracts, including digital/payments infrastructure procurement.

source_name: DREAM — Digital Reconstruction Ecosystem for Accountable Management (promo/partners)
why_relevant: State ecosystem co-designed with RISE Ukraine, TI Ukraine, OCP and BRDO. The partners page is an efficient actor-map expander; the platform itself publishes project-level data that eventually links to procurement. Relevant where reconstruction budgets touch financial/digital infrastructure.

source_name: Centre of Excellence in Procurement (CEP), Kyiv School of Economics — Центр вдосконалення закупівель
why_relevant: The named academic/analytical procurement centre in this cell. ~9 years of analytical research and digital procurement tools with >10k monthly users; project history with USAID, EBRD, OCP, Ukrenergo and several governments. Source of methodology and market-structure studies useful for interpreting banking-sector buyer behaviour.

source_name: StateWatch — незалежний аналітичний центр (sanctions, defence & public procurement analytics)
why_relevant: Think tank that co-designed NEW Prozorro risk indicators with the Prozorro team (contract-amendment focus; reportedly 4,195 triggers on >UAH 40bn of purchases in two weeks). This is exactly the 'watchdogs explain why tenders look that way' signal — and the amendment-risk lens applies directly to long-running banking IT/service contracts.

source_name: Наші гроші (Nashi Hroshi) — procurement investigative outlet
why_relevant: Oldest dedicated Ukrainian procurement-investigation outlet (Nikolov/Shalayskiy), publishing tender-by-tender exposés including NBU and state-bank purchases. Provides the narrative and named-actor layer that Prozorro data alone cannot give.
